name: DonutShop v0.7.18
body:
- "apply & state" on Dashboard has been moved to the 'hidden by default' Struct tab
  - Expert -> Options to show hidden tabs
- new DonutShop Memory card on Dashboard now shows the overall state
- gameID entries moved to PSRAM freeing up internal RAM
- HD-15 serial now restores previous baud rate after wake
- DonutShop can now detect when the IR Remote and the Auto-Sleep timer methods were used to sleep/wake and no longer requires a page refresh. Now all methods used to sleep/wake should be accounted for. Thanks to @haxman for bringing this to light.
